<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Facebook]] stocks drop 20% ([[US$]]118 billion), setting a record as the biggest single stock market loss in one day, and marking the first time that a stock lost over $100 billion in one day. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/07/26/facebook-on-pace-for-biggest-one-day-loss-in-value-for-any-company-sin.html (CNBC)]
*[[Walt Disney Parks and Resorts|Disney]] announces plans to eliminate all plastic straws and plastic stirrers from their parks by mid-2019. [https://articles.nola.com/business/index.ssf/2018/07/disney_no_more_plastic_straws.amp (NOLA)]

;International relations
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Hundreds of [[Sub-Saharan Africa]]n migrants storm a border fence in [[Spain]]'s [[North Africa]]n enclave of [[Ceuta]], using home-made flamethrowers and other improvised weapons. The [[Civil Guard (Spain)|Spanish Civil Guard]] reports that 602 people succeeded in reaching Ceuta, of whom 586 were taken to a temporary reception centre, while 16 others are being treated in a hospital. Fifteen border guards were also hurt. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jul/26/hundreds-storm-border-fence-spanish-enclave-north-africa-ceuta-spain-migration (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Capital punishment in Japan]]
**The six remaining cult members of [[Aum Shinrikyo]] who perpetrated the 1995 [[Tokyo subway sarin attack]] and were on death row are executed by hanging. [https://japantoday.com/category/crime/Japan-hangs-all-6-remaining-AUM-death-row-inmates (''Japan Today'')]
*[[Cannabis in the United Kingdom]]
**The [[UK]] [[Home Secretary]] [[Sajid Javid]] announces that [[Medical cannabis|medicinal cannabis]] products are to be legalized by the end of this year, allowing cannabis treatments to be legally prescribed by specialist doctors following several high profile cases. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-44968386 (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-cannabis/britain-to-legalize-medicinal-use-of-cannabis-idUSKBN1KG29E (Reuters)]
*A bomb explodes outside the [[Embassy of the United States, Beijing|U.S. Embassy in China]], wounding the lone assailant. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast/suspected-self-immolation-near-u-s-embassy-in-china-state-media-idUSKBN1KG0KP (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*A team of [[Russians|Russian]] scientists in collaboration with [[Princeton University]] announce in a new report that they have brought two female [[nematodes]] frozen in [[permafrost]] from around [[Pleistocene|42,000 years]] ago back to life. The two nematodes are now the oldest confirmed living animals on the planet. [http://siberiantimes.com/science/casestudy/news/worms-frozen-in-permafrost-for-up-to-42000-years-come-back-to-life/ (''The Siberian Times'')]
*Astronomers say they have observed [[Albert Einstein]]'s theory of [[gravitational redshift]] for the first time while observing a star known as [[S2 (star)|S2]] interact with a [[supermassive black hole]] using the [[Very Large Telescope]] (VLT). [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-44967491 (BBC)]
